comment: Status/evidence overrides merged by scripts/extract_requirements.py. The requirements index is generated; record implementation/test evidence here. Controlled status vocabulary: planned, in-progress, captured, implemented, tested, deferred, superseded. 'captured' means Phase 0 behavioral evidence exists; it does not mean the Rust implementation exists.

PRD-API-M1-001.note: Native v1 surface captured (Issue 5). OpenSubsonic and Jellyfin captures are Issues 6-7.

PRD-API-M1-004.note: Public-ID shapes and stability evidenced; migration-time preservation remains Phase 11 work.

PRD-API-M1-006.note: Parity matrix exists; client-used-uncaptured routes are the later-phase backlog.

PRD-STREAM-003.note: Release gate; cannot run until the Rust server exists. Client-side prerequisites inventoried.
